title: CommercialInvoice
description:
A commercial invoice: an itemized account of goods delivered together with a
demand for payment.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: Identifier assigned by the buyer to an order.

contractNumber.description:
Identifier of a contract concluded between parties such as between
buyer and seller.

invoiceNumber.description: Reference number to identify an invoice.

issueDate.description:
Date that a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or
otherwise authenticated.

invoiceDate.description: Date of issue of an invoice.

paymentDueDate.description:
Date when an amount due should be made available to the creditor under
the terms of payment.

billOfLadingNumber.description: Carrier-issued Bill of Lading or Waybill number for the shipment.

shippingMark.description:
Marks and numbers placed on packages to identify the consignment and
link physical goods to the document.

letterOfCreditNumber.description: Letter of Credit reference number if applicable for payment.

portOfEntry.description: Port where the goods will enter the destination country.

destinationCountry.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for final destination.

buyer.description: Party to which merchandise or services are sold.

invoicee.description: Party to whom an invoice is issued.

consignee.description: Party to whom the goods are consigned (may differ from buyer).

sellersBank.description: Bank designated by the seller to receive payment.

seller.description: Party selling merchandise or services to a buyer.

sellerBankAccountNumber.description: Identifier of an account with the bank designated to receive payment.

originalLoadingLocation.description:
Seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location
where the goods were first loaded onto the means of transport being
utilised for their carriage.

originCountry.description:
Name of the country in which the goods have been produced or
manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of
the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related
to trade.

tradeTermsConditionsDescription.description: Free form description of delivery or transport terms (Incoterms).

tradeTermsConditionsCode.description: Code specifying the delivery or transport terms (Incoterms).

paymentTerms.description:
Identification of the terms of payment between the parties to a
transaction (generic term).

paymentMethod.description: Code specifying a method of payment.

insuranceCost.description: Cost of insurance for the shipment.

allowancesCharges.description:
Discounts or surcharges applied at invoice level, after line item
totals and before the final total.

totalAmount.description: Total monetary amount charged in respect of one or more invoices.
